metadata.section_title: Protection from abuse, violence and exploitation.

text:
[Act: rpwd
 Chapter: Rights and Entitlements
 Section: 7::Protection from abuse, violence and exploitation.
]


(1) The appropriate Government shall take measures to protect persons with disabilities from all forms of abuse, violence and exploitation and to prevent the same, shall—
  (5) If the Executive Magistrate finds that the alleged act or behaviour constitutes an offence under the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860), or under any other law for the time being in force, he may forward the complaint to that effect to the Judicial or Metropolitan Magistrate, as the case may be, having jurisdiction in the matter.
